verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes threaded replies. Community hands-on reports do confirm that channel threading exists: one contrasts channels with DMs, which lack threading, and others describe following threads in channels. Those same users criticize the threading as confusing and poorly implemented, which caps quality but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of channel thread replies, evidence that side discussions stay reliably attached to the parent message, and threading in DMs/chats.
